title: Concept: Optional dependency resolved from disk
description: package.json declares a `file:` specifier in `optionalDependencies`, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: A dependency resolved from a local path or a mutable branch is not the published artifact the rest of the project audits. This rule reads a `file:` specifier in `optionalDependencies`.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through package.json (npm).
risk: A dependency resolved from a local path or a mutable branch is not the published artifact the rest of the project audits. This rule reads a `file:` specifier in `optionalDependencies`.
